prompt: In the following picture, ABCD is a square whose side is 8 inches long. What is the area of the shaded part?

solutions.title: Add the two triangles
solutions.body:
Each shaded triangle has its base on side DC and its top point on side AB.

- So each triangle's **height** is the side of the square: 8 inches.
- The two bases together cover all of DC: they add up to 8 inches.

Area of a triangle $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}$, so the total is

$\frac{1}{2} \times (\text{base}_1 + \text{base}_2) \times 8 = \frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times 8 = 32$.

**Answer: 32 square inches**

solutions.title: Half of each slice
solutions.body:
Draw a vertical line from the point where the two triangles meet on DC up to AB. This cuts the square into two rectangles, each 8 inches tall.

Each shaded triangle sits in one rectangle with the same base and the same height as the rectangle, so it covers **exactly half** of its rectangle.

Half of one rectangle + half of the other = half of the whole square.

$\frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times 8 = \frac{1}{2} \times 64 = 32$.

**Answer: 32 square inches**

prompt:
Ryan, Luke, Connor and Hunter worked on a science project together. However, one of them didn't participate in writing the report.

- Ryan said, "I participated in writing the report."
- Luke and Hunter said, "Connor didn't participate in writing the report."
- Connor said, "Luke and I participated in writing the report."

If we know two of them told the truth, and the other two lied, who didn't participate in writing the report?

solutions.title: Test each person
solutions.body:
Suppose each person in turn is the one who didn't help, and count the true statements.

| Didn't help | Ryan | Luke | Hunter | Connor | # true |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ryan | lie | lie | lie | true | 1 |
| Luke | true | lie | lie | lie | 1 |
| Connor | true | true | true | lie | 3 |
| Hunter | true | lie | lie | true | **2** ✓ |

Only "Hunter didn't help" gives exactly two truth-tellers.

**Answer: Hunter**

solutions.title: Luke and Hunter go together
solutions.body:
Luke and Hunter said **the same thing**, so they are either both telling the truth or both lying.

- If they both tell the truth (Connor didn't help), then Ryan's statement is also true — that's 3 truths. Too many. ✗
- So Luke and Hunter **both lied**, which means Connor **did** help. Then Ryan and Connor must both be telling the truth.
- Ryan is truthful, so Ryan helped. Connor is truthful, so Luke helped.

Ryan, Luke and Connor all helped, so the one who didn't is Hunter.

**Answer: Hunter**
